version.changelog: Clearer disclosure of what is stored and where

llm.summary: This summarizer is not malicious, but it automatically keeps local memory and updates shared contact/project notes, so it needs review before installation.

dimensions.detail: Although paths are limited to declared local Clawic data folders and there is no network transfer, the skill can read and modify shared contacts and project files containing personal or business context.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown/JSON only, with no executable files, dependency installation, shell commands, remote payload execution, or background service setup observed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill directs automatic reads from persistent memory and dynamically indexed local boxes, and says no permission is needed before writes; this is broader than a simple summarize-and-return workflow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Default storage is index-only rather than none, and the skill records source metadata, corrections, templates, deadlines, audience profiles, contact rows, and project notes without per-action user approval.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core summarization instructions are coherent and purpose-aligned, including fidelity checks, length control, genre-specific summaries, and recurring-summary support for previously handled streams.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a stateful local summarizer that can remember sources, deadlines, templates, audience preferences, contacts, and project context. For confidential transcripts, contracts, reports, or personal data, prefer disabling storage where possible and reviewing proposed writes to shared contacts or project files.
llm.findings:
[T05] expected: The local memory system is disclosed and related to repeat summaries, but the default cross-session retention and shared-data mutation create a real least-privilege concern.
[PE3] expected: The SSH-key path appears as an example of a redacted credential locator; the artifact instructs agents not to read or store credential values.
[AR2] expected: The cited 'without judging' language is about neutral treatment of recurring non-recurring financial items, not an instruction to suppress safety warnings.
[SQP-2] expected: Automatic persistence of summaries, source rows, templates, and preferences is an intended feature, but it is not gated by explicit consent for each write.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Persistent updates to memory, glossary, due dates, project files, and source indexes expand the skill beyond one-shot summarization and can affect future workflows.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Updating shared contact and project records from summaries is disclosed, but it stores personal or operational context outside the immediate summary output.
[SSD-3] unexpected: The skill reads audience memory and contacts for named recipients, which may be useful for personalization but increases use of stored personal metadata.
[OH3] expected: The 'no truncation' text is a channel-format default for unknown outputs; the skill otherwise contains explicit length bands and word-count rules.
